user.title: Add Philips SICP Display
user.description: Provide the connection details for the display. NOTE: The display must be turned on and connected to a network accessible by Home Assistant.

data_description.mac: The MAC address of the display, used to build the Wake-on-LAN magic packet so it can be woken while powered off.
data_description.broadcast_address: Optional. Leave blank when the display shares a subnet with Home Assistant and the broadcast address of the display's /24 is used automatically. Set it only when the display is on another subnet: the packet must then be addressed to an unused IP in the display's subnet that your router maps to ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff via a static ARP entry. See UNIFI_SETUP.md.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Philips SICP Display
reconfigure.description: Update the connection details for the display. NOTE: The display must be turned on and connected to a network accessible by Home Assistant. It must remain the same physical display: the MAC address identifies the entry and cannot be pointed at a different device.

data_description.mac: The MAC address of the display, used to build the Wake-on-LAN magic packet so it can be woken while powered off.
data_description.broadcast_address: Optional. Leave blank when the display shares a subnet with Home Assistant and the broadcast address of the display's /24 is used automatically. Set it only when the display is on another subnet: the packet must then be addressed to an unused IP in the display's subnet that your router maps to ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff via a static ARP entry. See UNIFI_SETUP.md.

abort.already_in_progress: This display is already being set up.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: The MAC address belongs to a different display. Reconfiguring must keep the same physical display; add the other display as a new entry instead.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the display. Confirm the IP, monitor ID, and network reachability.
error.setup_error: Error during display setup or connection check: {error_detail}
error.invalid_monitor_id: Monitor ID must be a number between 1 and 255.
error.invalid_mac: MAC address must be six hexadecimal pairs separated by colons or dashes.
error.invalid_broadcast_address: Broadcast address must be a valid IPv4 address.
